title: Subtractive Spectral Holography and the Fredholm Determinant Divisor: Constructing Algebraic Cycles via Schur-Tared Dirac Operators
description: Formal machine-verified Lean 4 proof and numerical probes introducing Subtractive Spectral Holography to realize higher-codimension algebraic cycles as the zero locus of Schur-tared Fredholm determinants. In this work, ai is being used as a tool to assist in formal verification, symbol auditing, and manuscript preparation.
